item.description:
Release v5.6.3

Changes since v5.6.2

  • feat(browserplugin): add BrowserAgentTool to agentTools
  • feat(ConversationInputPlugin): attach image files as base64 when dragged into composer
  • feat(MiniMaxVideoTool): route all network requests through kernel's NetworkProviding
  • feat(NetworkManagerPlugin): add download tool and split HTTPLogTools into individual files
  • feat(NetworkManagerPlugin): add searchPage and searchCount to HTTPExchangeStore
  • feat(NetworkManagerPlugin): skip inline rendering for large HTTP body payloads
  • fix(deepseek): remove duplicate/deprecated files after refactor
  • fix(LLMProvider): inject plugin data directory via storage API in onBoot
  • fix(NetworkManagerPlugin): center code block with GeometryReader and add missing localizations
  • fix(OnboardingPlugin): delay ViewModel creation until onReady to use correct storage directory
  • refactor(deepseek): add Anthropic protocol support and restructure provider architecture
  • refactor(deepseek): move pure data types into a Models directory
  • refactor(MiniMaxVideoTool): return download URL instead of downloading video binary
  • refactor(networkmanager): drop auto-refresh on HTTP exchange settings
  • refactor(NetworkManagerPlugin): replace fixed-directory download with NSSavePanel text export for large payloads
  • refactor(toolmanager): extract usage statistics into its own settings tab
  • trash: delete unnecessary code or files
